title: The old guard of languages fades
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and plain JavaScript lose share of stories.
expect: If true, the share of stories mentioning Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails or JavaScript should be at most 0.8x as high in the latest 12 months as in all earlier stories since 2006 (pooled) (0.95x is weak, 1.1x or higher refutes it).

check.per_label: Java, PHP, Ruby, Rails and JavaScript share of stories

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
